rationale: Approved explicitly after the 2026-09-11 reboot showed that the in-memory fixture catalog loses every table registration
Approved explicitly; bytes are measured on the declared 2 vCPU 7.7 GiB VM with the file layout recorded, and the VM decision for timing is deferred to before H10B/H11 timing

Approved explicitly; footprint counts every object reachable from the metadata of retained snapshots, including older metadata JSON still listed in metadata_log_entries, and objects in the table location that no metadata references are reported separately and never counted

Approved explicitly; the manuscript headline for B3 is the total that includes the materialized serving table because that table is part of the treatment as designed, and the store-versus-serving decomposition is reported in the same table so the reader sees that the B3 cost on this fixture comes from serving materialization, not from the vintage store

Approved explicitly; the declared praktikum-sd VM with 2 vCPU and 7.7 GiB is frozen as the timing environment for H10B and H11 because no larger node is available, so every treatment is timed on identical hardware and the numbers are comparative between treatments, never a performance or scalability claim

Approved explicitly; the 1067008 unreferenced bytes left in the experiment table locations by the 2026-09-09 run that lost its catalog registration are removed with remove_orphan_files before the H10B measurement so later location listings contain only objects the current run wrote
